name: s81sl_capc-s81sl_capc-COMMIT
purpose: S81U-CAP2 / S81-CAPRT 10-19: capture root as a wires-only cluster of the CLOSED s81sl_cap_rt (c302169ce) and s81sl_cap_tr views.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_s81sl_cap u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS -DOT_HARD_CHILDREN --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_dv/slice/ot_s81sl_cap.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81sl_capc/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81sl_capc/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81sl_capc --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_s81sl_cap --macro-view physical/ref_tile/s81sl_cap_rt/views/ot_s81sl_cap_rt --macro-view physical/ref_tile/s81sl_cap_tr/views/ot_s81sl_cap_tr > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: S81U-CAP2: the flat s81sl_cap (22,261 sinks / one root, TT insertion 368.5 ps > 300) as a wires-only cluster of 3 hardened leaves with own roots: root leaf s81sl_cap_rt (S), tree leaf s81sl_cap_tr x2 (N; E instance MY). Seams registered both sides (nc RST flop -> n6 P1 flop), no added edge. S81-CAPRT 10-19: children are the CLOSED views (cap_rt c302169ce R 258.7 TT / 210.3 FF; cap_tr R 140.7 / 113.6); child_clock_ref boundary so the spine targets each child's routed boundary R (118 ps TT compensation rt vs tr). cap_rt resets 2 cycles after cap_tr (its 2-stage reset landing); no data crosses before a job starts.
